subject: Error: contains a blank line with install_github()

messages.author: 6a3b777d6a18967b
messages.subject: Error: contains a blank line with install_github()
parts:
I've just opened a new version of choroplethr for beta testing and it turns out that the package can no longer be installed with devtools install_github().  I'm wondering if someone can help me understand and fix the error .  

> install_github("choroplethr", "trulia")
Installing github repo choroplethr/master from trulia
Downloading choroplethr.zip from https://github.com/trulia/choroplethr/archive/master.zip
Installing package from /var/folders/19/tp3bd8zj3nn559nhlllgsyc457_rdd/T//RtmpDozT1c/choroplethr.zip
arguments 'minimized' and 'invisible' are for Windows only
Installing choroplethr
'/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/R' --vanilla CMD INSTALL  \
  '/private/var/folders/19/tp3bd8zj3nn559nhlllgsyc457_rdd/T/RtmpDozT1c/devtools109263d65662/choroplethr-master'  \
  --library='/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.0/Resources/library' --install-tests 

Error: contains a blank line
Error: Command failed (1)
> 

Where is the blank line?  What should be not blank?  I thought it was enough that my repo passes R CMD check :)  

I did the obvious things like call update.packages(), ensured that the package was not present on my computer already and so on.  I also verified that the problem is not with install_github() because I could install the dev version of ggplot2.  

Here is my sessionInfo()

> sessionInfo()
R version 3.0.2 (2013-09-25)
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin10.8.0 (64-bit)

locale:
[1] en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8/C/en_US.UTF-8/en_US.UTF-8

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base     

other attached packages:
[1] devtools_1.4.1

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
 [1] digest_0.6.4   evaluate_0.5.1 formatR_0.10   httr_0.2       knitr_1.5      memoise_0.1    parallel_3.0.2 RCurl_1.95-4.1
 [9] stringr_0.6.2  tools_3.0.2    whisker_0.3-2 
> 

Any help would be appreciated. 

Thanks.

Ari
